主要内容: On January 31, 2013, Samuel Sarpong was terminated as Chief Financial Officer of Broadway Financial Corporation and its subsidiary, Broadway Federal Bank. Brenda Battey, former Senior Controller of Bank of Manhattan, is acting as Interim Chief Financial Officer, subject to regulatory approval. The change in leadership may affect the company's financial operations and strategic direction in the short term. The company's CEO, Wayne-Kent A. Bradshaw, signed the report on February 6, 2013, confirming the change in management. This event is reported under Item 5.02 of the Form 8-K filing, which details the departure of directors or certain officers. The filing was made on February 6, 2013, following the event on January 31, 2013. The company's headquarters are located at 4800 Wilshire Boulevard, Los Angeles, California 90010, with a phone number of (323) 634-1700. The company is incorporated in Delaware and has a Commission File Number of 000-27464 and an IRS Employer Identification Number of 95-4547287.
